description: The celebration will include welcoming remarks from Bryan K. Jensen and State Representative Gayle Manning, free trees for the first 30 Avon residents, planting and pruning demonstrations, food and drinks available for purchase, and live music by Curt Vigg and the Avon High School Jazz Band.
